text:
Hydrated copper(II) sulfate is blue. When it is heated it forms white anhydrous copper(II) sulfate.
How is a sample of anhydrous copper(II) sulfate changed into hydrated copper(II) sulfate?
A
Water is added.
B
It is cooled down.
C
It is heated up.
D
Water is removed.
subject: Chemistry
